results.title: Next.js Developer Internship
results.description:
**Overview**

**Build Real Products. Learn Through Execution.**

**About Qurovo**

Qurovo is an emerging HealthTech startup building a digital platform to help people make informed healthcare and hospital decisions.

We are looking for aspiring developers who enjoy building web applications, solving problems and learning through hands-on product development.

**What You'll Work On**

- Develop and improve product features using Next.js.
- Build responsive interfaces and reusable components.
- Work with APIs and backend integrations.
- Debug issues and improve application performance.
- Contribute to the development of our live HealthTech platform.

**What We're Looking For**

- Practical experience with Next.js, React.js and JavaScript.
- Understanding of HTML, CSS, responsive design and API integration.
- Familiarity with Git and GitHub.
- Problem-solving skills, curiosity and willingness to learn.
- Ability to take ownership and complete assigned tasks.

**Portfolio Requirements**

We would love to see what you have built!

- Share links to 1–2 live websites or web applications you have developed.
- Include your GitHub profile and relevant repositories.
- Briefly mention your contribution to each project.

We value working projects and demonstrated skills. Personal projects are equally welcome.

**Internship Details**

- **Duration:** 3 Months
- **Mode:** Remote
- **Commitment:** 4-6 Hours/Day (Flexible Schedule)
- **Type:** Unpaid, Learning-Focused Internship

**If you enjoy building, experimenting and turning ideas into working products, we'd love to hear from you!**

**Role Description:**

We are seeking a highly skilled **Next.js & React Developer** to design, develop, and support modern, scalable web applications. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in **React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, and headless CMS architectures**, along with experience supporting enterprise-grade digital platforms. Exposure to **Sitecore XM Cloud and Headless implementations** will be a significant advantage.

**Location: Melbourne.**

**Salary: AUD 108571 - 119893 Annual Gross.**

Please Note: - The above salary range is only indicative and maybe subject to suitable enhancements, based on internal company processes  
**Flexible working arrangements (hybrid, reviewed case-by-case basis). Feel free to connect with your recruiter to learn more about how this works in practice.**

## **Key Responsibilities:**

- Design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications using **React.js** and **Next.js**.
- Build high-performance, responsive, and accessible user interfaces following modern front-end development practices.
- Implement and optimize **Server-Side Rendering (SSR)**, **Static Site Generation (SSG)**, and **Incremental Static Regeneration (ISR)**.

- Integrate applications with REST APIs, GraphQL services, authentication platforms, and headless CMS solutions.

* * *

- **7+ years** of overall web application development experience.
- **4+ years** of hands-on experience with React.js.
- **3+ years** of experience developing enterprise applications using Next.js.
- Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

* * *

### Next.js Expertise

- Server-Side Rendering (SSR)
- Static Site Generation (SSG)
- Incremental Static Regeneration (ISR)
- App Router and Routing Strategies
- API Routes
- Middleware Implementation
- Caching and Performance Optimization
- Next.js Application Architecture

- React.js
- TypeScript
- JavaScript (ES6+)
- HTML5
- CSS3
- Tailwind CSS
- Responsive Web Design
- Component-Driven Development
- State Management Solutions

### **Platform & Integration**

- REST APIs
- GraphQL
- Authentication & Authorization Integrations
- Headless CMS Architectures
- Azure-hosted Solutions
- Web Application Security Best Practices

### **Production Support & Operations :**

- L2/L3 Production Support
- Incident and Problem Management
- Application Troubleshooting
- Performance Monitoring & Diagnostics
- GitHub and Source Control Management
- Release and Deployment Support

* * *

## Preferred Skills – Sitecore

Experience in any of the following will be highly desirable:

- Sitecore XM Cloud
- Sitecore Headless Services
- Sitecore Experience Edge
- Sitecore JSS (JavaScript Services)
- Sitecore Content Modeling
- Sitecore Personalization
- Sitecore Components & Rendering Architecture
- Sitecore Content Authoring and Publishing Workflows

* * *

## **Soft Skills :**

- Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
- Ability to work independently in a global delivery environment.
- Proactive approach to troubleshooting and continuous improvement.

* * *

**ADDITIONALSkills:**

1. Excellent customer-facing skills
2. Excellent written and verbal communication skills
3. Strong attention to detail and outstanding analytical and problem-solving skills.
